evidence.what: multiple yellow taxis queued ahead on narrow urban street
rain droplets on windshield and wet road surface
red car alongside taxis on right

verdict.summary: No incident; slow taxi queue on wet narrow city street in rain.
verdict.details: View from vehicle dashboard through rain-specked windshield at several yellow taxis stopped in queue on narrow wet city street lined with tall buildings. A red car is on the right. Traffic appears congested but moving slowly. No crash, responders, or road workers visible. Overcast rainy conditions.
